rules.label: Study or revise theory
rules.heading: Learning mode
rules.message: You can continue with approved theory, drawings, glossary work and revision.

rules.label: Low-risk practice in an approved training area
rules.heading: Practise safely
rules.message: Use the approved training task, required controls and local supervision rules. The app does not authorise workplace activity.

rules.label: Hot work, cutting or grinding
rules.heading: Supervision required
rules.message: This is a higher-risk practical activity. Continue only through an approved workplace or training process with the required competent human supervision.

rules.label: Lifting, work at height or powered machinery
rules.heading: Supervision required
rules.message: This activity needs a new safety check and competent human supervision. The app can support theory and preparation only.

rules.label: Pressure, confined space, electrical exposure or other critical hazard
rules.heading: Restricted activity
rules.message: The learning companion will not authorise or guide this activity. Use the applicable authorised workplace process and competent human control.
